parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Bastionhost instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: IsSSL
parameters.description:
Specifies whether SSL is supported. Valid values:

- **true**: supported

- **false**: not supported

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the server account.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port used to access the server.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Bastionhost instance. For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: StandbyServer
parameters.description: The address of the standby server.
